sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks for
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Sessions, Facebook, TikTok and the app's own event reporting from collecting usage data.
Hides banner, native and full-screen ads.
Hides the promotional banner and video on the launch splash screen and the full-screen offer on the home screen.
Colors the status bar and navigation bar white to match the app's screens.
Removes the update prompts that block the app at launch.
